annotations.title: Confirm an owner with a code

description: Use this when a human received the 6-digit confirmation code and you need to mark that owner verified so they can receive updates and open tasks. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), owner_id (required), code (required; 6 digits). Returns the owner {id, inbox_id, email, status, digest, created_at, verified_at, unsubscribed_at}. A verified owner is returned again. Fails with 400 confirm_invalid, 400 confirm_expired, 400 confirm_locked, 404 owner_not_found, or 404 inbox_not_found.

code.description: 6-digit confirmation code from the confirmation email

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

owner_id.description: Owner id (own_…) returned when the owner was registered

name: cooper_confirm_owner

confirmation.description: State of the confirmation email that was sent.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

unsubscribed_at.description: ISO-8601 time the owner unsubscribed, or null.

verified_at.description: ISO-8601 time the owner confirmed, or null.

title: Confirm an owner with a code
